lines: How long will it remain this way?
You probably intend to stay alone.
Gradually you begin to hate yourself.
telling yourself that, up to today.
Just a little, just a little, make me think that.
It seems I’ve also become stronger.
I have faced it up to now.
I don’t know, I don’t know—just my feelings.
Now, I’ll go to tell you.
I wish I’d never fallen in love.
I thought that then, and that night.
Now, I’m falling in love again.
Just a little, just a little, make me think that.
